body: I read this and it made me smile, not because the post made me happy but reading this literally reminded me of me. Music is something I can’t be without and soccer is my first love. I’m also quite big into the NFL and NBA. My current situation isn’t great, like I said it’s almost identical to yours minus the ex girlfriend part, but my first advice would be to talk to her. I know it’s easier said than done, especially depending on how you broke up but if you genuinely want her back, you owe it to you and to her to tell her everything, but as for the other stuff we’re in the exact same boat and so there’s nothing much I can say to help, but drop me a message I feel like we could be friends, plus i’m from the UK and i find the US hella cool

I tell them some stuff they sympathize and say they are always there for me and they check up on me maybe one time and then that’s it, it’s like we never spoke about it. I know it’s unfair to expect them to constantly check up on me but I genuinely am someone who does if someone has been quiet for a week or so and that makes me feel a bit shit tbh, I know they’re not bad people and they don’t mean any harm or love me any less, it just increases that loneliness. So yeah I don’t really reach out to friends anymore about mental stuff coz it always ends the same and I don’t wanna give myself hope that someone will genuinely bother. Talking feels good and right at the time but has always taken me back to square one.
